body:
Hey again everyone. Time to announce the winners of the Greenhouse contest, and one clarification regarding the Parkour Rush.

🪴Greenhouse: Build Contest Winners

  • 🥇1st Place: @Starmarsh™, @J_, and @໓คriค! Your warp is set as Rafflesia, as requested.

  • 🥈2nd Place: @J1mbers, @Krashafa, and @ElectricSparx! I've set your warp as SerraLontana, but LMK if you want it changed!

  • 🥉3rd Place: A tie!

    • @Hollow and @jpguitar27! Your warp is set as Eden, as requested.

    • @Maidl, @TroyTheCrafter, and @Shotdown01! Your warp is set as Greenhouse4, though feel free to request a rename!

Thanks so much to the submitters. We've done the prizes a bit differently this time, using voucher items to redeem your silver, Trial points, and/or charm slot. These vouchers are in the reward bundles, which are in your ender chest, or in your inventory if your ender chest is full.

‼️Parkour Rush Notice

Just wanted to make something clear about the Parkour Rush now that it's over - the loot chest reset from the rush is permanent, not just for the rush. If you've already beaten any parkours, you can now go beat them again whenever you feel like it! Only catch is Raceway won't give a charm slot again. Apologies that this was unclear.

🫶
